chapter: Opening and childhood on the West Bank
title: Birthdate and how George Stephens became 'Tex'
summary: Born June 10, 1921, he explains the nickname came from cowboy hats brought back from relatives in Houston, and that it stuck in business and fraternities.

story.theme_name: Stating your name and birth date on tape
story.community_name: Opening the tape: name, birth date and birthplace

blocks.x: June 10th, 1921. My name is George E. Stevens Jr. Everybody calls me Tex. That name stuck with me. I have relatives in Houston, Texas. And during the summer, I would go after school and after college some years into Houston where my relatives are. And I would come back with the big cowboy hat, being tall and wearing the hat. They started calling me Tex years ago. So they seem like they forgot about my first name. And the name just stuck. So I just started using it in business and everywhere I went. Even the various fraternities that I belong to. I just signed Tex Stevens and everybody worldwide know who I am. Because I belong to the Prince Hall Masonic Lodge, which is the largest black fraternal organization in the world. So that's how the name stuck. But all in all, I'm just enjoying life for these 74 years.
As a kid, I mean kids would call you that?

Well, around about 10, 12 years of age they started calling me that. Maybe a little later, around 12, 13 or something like that. That I was aware of it. Did you say you were born here in New Orleans? I was born in New Orleans.
